scope: First five completed cases in the 93-image CPU-only expansion; partial review, not a cohort-wide conclusion
panels_reviewed: raw-score DAPI with independent StarDist outlines

reviewed_cases.visual_observation: Bright virtual DAPI foci align with several dark H&E nuclei, but intensity and boundary contrast vary; it does not clear the fixed AUC or contrast gates.
Dense H&E nuclear field; virtual DAPI is diffuse and contains dark cores in many outlined nuclei. The boundary-contrast gate fails.
Dense H&E nuclear field; the DAPI panel has bright inter-nuclear texture and weak nuclear localization. The boundary-contrast gate fails.
H&E includes a large pale lumen; virtual DAPI forms a bright rim near it and is nearly flat over many StarDist outlines. Spatial-shadow and alignment gates fail.
Sparse nucleated tissue surrounds a red-cell-rich region; some DAPI foci coincide with nuclei, but a localized broad bright patch and the spatial gate raise concern.

limits: Visual observations are from thumbnails, not raw virtual marker histology. No failed case is qualified by this review. All remaining completed cases and all channels of any QC-passing case require later review.
